id.description: Identifier of the rule, assigned by the backend when absent and kept on every update.

shape.description: Shape of the rule, that is what is measured.

eventNames.description: Mixpanel events the rule measures, any of them counting. Optional on INACTIVITY only, where none means the common core.

anchorEventNames.description: Events the measure starts from, the first of any of them: the start of a MILESTONE (the credentials when none) or the base of a COVERAGE (any event when none). Ignored by the other shapes.

property.description: Event property read by the rule: the id counted by a COVERAGE, the number averaged by a PROPERTY_AVERAGE, the id of the objects of an INACTIVITY per object.

windowValue.description: Size of the rolling window, in unit, ending on the evaluation date. Required on CADENCE, COVERAGE and PROPERTY_AVERAGE.

unit.description: Time unit of the window, and of the thresholds on MILESTONE and INACTIVITY.

perActiveUser.description: Whether a CADENCE is divided by the active users of the tenant, for actions every user does.

inactivityScope.description: What an INACTIVITY looks at: the tenant, each of its users or each of its objects. Absent means the tenant.

closingEventNames.description: Events that close an object of an INACTIVITY per object, any of them taking it out of the ones measured.

userRoles.description: Roles of the users an INACTIVITY per user looks at, from the roles of the user in Rocket. Absent or empty means all.

direction.description: Which side of the thresholds is good. Required on CADENCE and PROPERTY_AVERAGE, implied by the other shapes.

greenThreshold.description: Value up to which, on the good side, the tenant is compliant. In percent on COVERAGE.

yellowThreshold.description: Value up to which, past the green one, the tenant is at risk rather than failing. In percent on COVERAGE.

minSample.description: Smallest number of occurrences the measure needs: events of a PROPERTY_AVERAGE, distinct base values of a COVERAGE. Below it the tenant is not assessable. Absent means one.

observationOnly.description: Whether the rule is only measured, without judging the tenants, while its thresholds are being set.
